title: Paired bluetooth devices are listed as "Available" when their bluetooth adapter is disabled and multiple adapters are present
line: With several Bluetooth adapters, devices paired to a turned off adapter now appear under "Unavailable" instead of "Available".
explanation: The device list shared by the Bluetooth applet and the KCM sorts devices into Blocked, Connected and Available sections and never looked at whether the device's adapter is powered. With a single adapter this is hidden by the "Bluetooth is disabled" placeholder, but with two adapters and one turned off, that adapter's paired devices were shown as Available with a Connect button. DevicesProxyModel now gives those devices an "Unavailable" section and sorts it below Available (above Blocked); it updates live when the adapter is turned on or off.

commits.message:
applet: list devices of a turned off adapter as unavailable

With more than one adapter, paired devices of an adapter that is turned
off were still listed under "Available" although they can't be used. Put
them in their own "Unavailable" section, sorted below available devices.

BUG: 510884

Bluetooth applet: same, the headset is under Available
Bluetooth applet: the headset is under Unavailable
